name: TriRank
tagline: TriRank connects Google Search Console and checks whether AI answer engines cite your site.
description: TriRank pulls real clicks, impressions and rankings from Google Search Console. Every few days it asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode (and Grok on paid plans) your tracked questions and records whether your domain is cited. It drafts long-form content with internal links and a cover image for WordPress, Ghost or Webflow — you publish. Free one-time audit of any domain against homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and llms.txt.
